initial_plan.can_answer: partly: it compares motorist and cyclist deaths as shares of their combined deaths, but does not show the absolute number killed
initial_plan.metric: For each calendar year, cyclist deaths as a percentage of combined motorist and cyclist deaths; motorist share is the complement, with each component obtained by summing its crash-level killed count
initial_plan.denominator: Annual combined motorist plus cyclist deaths
initial_plan.population: People recorded as motorists or cyclists killed in police-reported NYC motor vehicle crashes whose crash_date falls from 2013-01-01 through 2025-12-31, represented by summing crash-level counts
initial_plan.filters: crash_date in calendar years 2013 through 2025; no borough or location filter
initial_plan.years: Calendar years derived from crash_date, 2013-2025 inclusive
initial_plan.grouping: Calendar year and road-user group (motorist, cyclist), plotted as annual percentages of the combined two-group total

data_check.crash_date: 0 missing and 0 known sentinel dates (1900-01-01, 1970-01-01, 0001-01-01) among eligible rows; DATE type cannot represent invalid calendar dates; each year 2013-2025 has observed dates from January 1 through December 31
data_check.decision: Keep all eligible rows. No rows within the planned dates are dropped or counted differently due to missing/default filter/group values or missing summed death counts; all 13 requested years have full observed calendar coverage. This framing's combined denominator includes only recorded motorist and cyclist deaths, so other road-user groups do not enter its shares.

final_plan.can_answer: partly: compare the relative composition of motorist and cyclist deaths, but not the absolute number killed
final_plan.metric: For each calendar year, motorist deaths and cyclist deaths as percentages of their combined total; sum each crash-level killed count by group and divide by that year's sum of the two groups
final_plan.denominator: The annual total of motorist plus cyclist deaths
final_plan.population: People recorded as motorists or cyclists killed in police-reported NYC motor vehicle crashes with crash_date in 2013-2025; all eligible crash rows retained
final_plan.filters: crash_date >= 2013-01-01 and < 2026-01-01; no borough or other location filter
final_plan.years: Complete calendar years 2013 through 2025, derived from crash_date
final_plan.grouping: Calendar year and road-user group (motorist, cyclist), plotted as shares of the annual combined two-group total
final_plan.limitations: The data check found 2,132,218 eligible crash rows, all years 2013-2025 observed from January 1 to December 31, 0 missing crash dates within the selected population, and 0 missing values in either killed-count column. This is only the relative split between motorist and cyclist deaths; it excludes other road-user groups from the denominator and does not give absolute death counts or exposure-adjusted rates. Crashes with missing crash_date cannot be assigned to a requested year and fall outside the date filter.
